turn_prompts: Synthesize the frozen research evidence into a typed task specification and VerificationContract.

The verification_contract is consumed by a strict host decoder. Its complete JSON object has exactly these six keys and no others: {"format":"harbor.verification-contract.v1","version":"1","command":["sh","/oracle/tests/test.sh","wasm32-unknown-unknown"],"workdir":".","coverage_mode":"browser_wasm","allowed_solution_paths":["SORTED_PATH"]}. It must use `format`, never `schema_version`. `version` is the JSON string "1", not a number. Do not use contract_id, task_id, repository, required_checks, assertions, preconditions, evidence_basis, or any task-level verification fields. All behavioral detail belongs only in task_specification. allowed_solution_paths must be sorted and supported by frozen evidence.

Before submitting, compare verification_contract byte-for-byte in shape with the six-key template: no extra field is accepted. Check that every contract command and source path is supported by evidence, then resolve inconsistencies without inventing facts.

Completion requires exactly one harbor_submit_output tool call, never a prose final answer. Submit every declared output with {"verdict":"pass","artifacts":[{"name":"DECLARED_OUTPUT_NAME","content":"STRUCTURED_ARTIFACT"}]}; use the exact declared name and one entry for each declared output.
